stemMarkdown: Find the amount (in Rs.) when Rs. 18000 is invested for 1 year at 15% per annum compound interest, compounded half-yearly. (Round to 2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Half-yearly compounding halves the rate and doubles the periods: 7.5% for 2 periods. $A = 18000\left(1 + \dfrac{7.5}{100}\right)^{2} = 20801.25$.
altSolutionMarkdown: Compounding more often beats annual compounding: at 15% compounded annually the amount would only be $20700.00$.
